name: advance_unchecked
declaration: unsafe fn advance_unchecked (& mut self , n : usize) -> & mut Self
documentation:
Advances the cursor by asserting that `n` bytes have been filled.

 After advancing, the `n` bytes are no longer accessible via the cursor and can only be
 accessed via the underlying buffer. I.e., the buffer's filled portion grows by `n` elements
 and its unfilled portion (and the capacity of this cursor) shrinks by `n` elements.

 # Safety

 The caller must ensure that the first `n` bytes of the cursor have been properly
 initialised.
rules: The caller must ensure that the first `n` bytes of the cursor have been properly initialized before calling `advance_unchecked(n)`.
